long_biography.plain_text:
Shahid "Shad" Khan arrived in Illinois from Lahore at 16 to study industrial engineering. A student job at Flex-N-Gate became the setting for his breakthrough: a one-piece truck bumper formed without welds that could corrode. He left to create Bumper Works around the design. In 1980 he purchased Flex-N-Gate and folded the younger company into his former employer, giving him a platform for wider automotive manufacturing.

Khan later moved into sport and entertainment. He acquired the Jacksonville Jaguars and Fulham Football Club, linking an NFL franchise with one of London's oldest professional clubs, and launched All Elite Wrestling with his son Tony. The clubs and promotion placed him in public-facing institutions far removed from factory floors, while Flex-N-Gate remained the industrial platform created by his bumper innovation.
